title: The Institution of the Feast of Purim
description: Mordecai and Queen Esther sent letters to all the Jews in the kingdom of Ahasuerus, establishing the 14th and 15th days of the month of Adar as an annual festival to commemorate when sorrow was turned into joy. These days are to be celebrated with feasting, gladness, giving gifts to one another, and giving gifts to the poor. They are called Purim after the word pur (lot). [ref:Est 9:19-32|Esther 9:19-32]
